_about: Settings for tools/scout.py. 'tesla' is scanned every day for TrendingTesla. 'candidates' are possible niches for a second (and third) channel, scanned every Sunday. Add, remove or reword niches freely; each search query costs 100 of the 10,000 daily YouTube API units, so keep it to about 2 queries per niche.
